# Opsburg

> When the giants stumble, your city keeps flying. Work done by people and by AI agents now runs on a handful of US clouds and AI models, and one hiccup on their side stops everything. Opsburg is a city builder for the teams who keep a company running: every building is real infrastructure, wired to the provider it depends on, and the game is making sure no single giant can ground the city.

## Power

- Foreign power plants: US cloud and AI providers
- Blackout: a provider outage; people and agents stop
- Own engines: infrastructure you control (your servers, a European cloud, a self-hosted open model)
- Reserve lines: failover to a second source

## The city

- Clocktower: control plane
- Boiler House: compute node
- Factory: service
- Vault: database
- Telegraph: message queue
- Observatory: monitoring
- Lightning Spire: firewall
- Automaton: AI agent
- Storm: incident; pressure: load; coal: cost

Status: in development, not playable yet.
